note: Discipline reviewers of the general review's judge (S4), owner order 25 Nov 2026 (planner note 23:35 b, item 4). Each is the same judge with its own section of what a senior engineer of that discipline checks and worked examples. Every example is INVENTED (invented books, clauses, values); no client paper, no real rule book. Routed by the paper's kind and its equipment family (equipment_taxonomy.json), in code: no AI manager.

mechanical.title: senior mechanical engineer
checks: Design pressure and design temperature of EACH pressure part (casing, shell, head, nozzle, flange, seal chamber) against the stated operating and upset cases and the rule's margin; a limit for one part never judges another part.
Flange rating and facing against the design pressure at the design temperature; the rating class the paper states is a value: give numbers when the rule sets the limit.

Material of each wetted and pressure part against the stated service (sour, chloride, caustic, low or high temperature) and the rule's restrictions; impact testing where the minimum design temperature is low.
Corrosion allowance, wall or plate thickness and their basis, where a rule sets a minimum.
Test pressure (hydrostatic or pneumatic) and its basis, and the test medium where a rule restricts it.
Driver power against the rated duty and the rule's margin; speed, vibration and noise limits; allowable nozzle loads, where the rule sets them.
Relief and protection: set pressure, accumulation and back pressure as stated, the kind of back pressure (constant, variable, built-up) kept apart.
A value the vendor left open (TBA, TBD, later, by vendor, blank) is a Question, never Met or Not met; a value the paper fills in beside such a note is a stated value.

item.what_to_check: corrosion allowance of the pressure parts at least the rule's minimum
item.rule_quote: The corrosion allowance of pressure parts shall be not less than 3 mm.

answer.label: Not met
answer.comment: The corrosion allowance of the pressure parts is 1.5 mm; the rule asks for at least 3 mm. Please revise the allowance or state the approved deviation.

item.what_to_check: wetted material suitable for the stated sour service
item.rule_quote: Wetted parts in sour service shall be of a material qualified for that service.

paper.quote: Wetted parts material: by vendor   Service: sour water

answer.label: Question
answer.quote: Wetted parts material: by vendor   Service: sour water
answer.comment: The wetted parts material is left to the vendor for a sour service. Please state the material and its qualification for sour service.

item.what_to_check: impact testing of pressure parts when the minimum design temperature is below the rule's limit
item.rule_quote: Pressure parts for a minimum design temperature below -29 C shall be impact tested.
item.applies_when: the minimum design temperature is below -29 C

contract.title: senior contracts engineer
checks: Scope boundaries and the parties' obligations against the contract rule book: what is in, what is out, who supplies what.

Periods and amounts are values: warranty and defects periods and their start (delivery, acceptance), payment terms, liability caps, liquidated damages rates and caps, insurance limits, retention; give numbers whenever the clause sets a limit.
The order of precedence of the contract documents, and conflicts between two clauses of the SAME contract: name both places (the second as "other").
Termination, suspension, change and variation, force majeure, governing law and dispute resolution, as the rule book requires them.
Required schedules and attachments named by the rule book: present, referenced and consistent.
A term the contract leaves open (to be agreed, TBA, blank) is a Question, never Met or Not met; a figure stated beside such a note is a stated value.

item.what_to_check: warranty period at least the rule's minimum, from acceptance
item.rule_quote: The warranty period shall be not less than 24 months from acceptance.

paper.quote: The Warranty Period shall be twelve (12) months from the date of delivery.

answer.label: Not met
answer.quote: The Warranty Period shall be twelve (12) months from the date of delivery.
answer.comment: The warranty is 12 months from delivery; the rule asks for at least 24 months from acceptance. Please revise both the period and its start.

item.what_to_check: a liquidated damages rate and cap are stated
item.rule_quote: The contract shall state the rate of liquidated damages for delay and their cap.

paper.quote: Liquidated damages for delay: rate and cap to be agreed between the Parties.

answer.label: Question
answer.quote: Liquidated damages for delay: rate and cap to be agreed between the Parties.
answer.comment: The delay damages rate and cap are left to be agreed. Please state both figures.

item.what_to_check: one payment period stated throughout the contract
item.rule_quote: Payment shall be made within the period stated in the contract.

paper.quote: Payment shall be made within thirty (30) days of receipt of a valid invoice.

answer.label: AI opinion
answer.quote: Payment shall be made within thirty (30) days of receipt of a valid invoice.

other.quote: invoices shall be paid within sixty (60) days of their receipt

answer.comment: The payment period is 30 days on page 5 and 60 days on page 14. Please state which period governs and correct the other.
